name: Moncler
why: Down jackets, from a French alpine equipment maker turned Italian-owned luxury brand.
origin: Founded in Monestier-de-Clermont, France, in 1952; the name abbreviates the village.

notes.fren: the mirror case — born French-alpine, naturalized Italian
notes.ski: Grenoble, 1952, and the first jackets were built for alpine expeditions rather than for town. The Grenoble line keeps the claim current rather than historical.

notes.craft: Moncler's 2024 annual report says the brand owns a down-jacket plant in Romania (over 2,000 staff) and a plant at Trebaseleghe (Padua), plus a new knitwear plant in Veneto, but that outerwear and knitwear are only 'partly managed internally' with the rest made by about 130 façon and finished-goods suppliers, and accessories and footwear are fully outsourced. Real owned making of the core category, not the whole range: a 4.

craft_evidence.owned_d: Moncler Group 2024 Annual Report p.17: cut-make-trim done 'both by third party manufacturers (façon manufacturers) and in the Moncler manufacturing plant in Trebaseleghe (Padua)'; owned plant in Romania (Bacau, Industries Yield; set up 2015, moved 2016, expanded 2022) employing 'more than 2,000 people'; a new knitwear plant inaugurated in Veneto in 2024. Outerwear and knitwear 'partly managed internally and partly assigned to third party manufacturers'; accessories and footwear made by third parties. 2023 NFS calls Romania an 'industrial and technological R&D hub for down jackets'. Brand-owned (Moncler S.p.A. group), not a parent's.
craft_evidence.countries: NC — PDPs blocked by robots.txt (moncler.com). Annual report: production in owned plants in Romania and Italy (Trebaseleghe; Veneto knitwear) plus façon makers 'primarily' in Eastern Europe; 130 Moncler-brand suppliers, top 30 ~80% of supply value. No PDP share possible.
